answers.core:
I'm looking to have GradientTexture2D modified, which can only be done in core. From what I can see, an add-on doesn't have the ability to create proper Texture resource sub-classes in order to add a "CustomRadialGradientTexture2D" resource of sorts. 

The most an add-on could do in this scenario from my understanding is create and draw to a viewport, then get the viewport texture. Or draw pixel by pixel to an image on the CPU which is slow.
answers.workaround: It could be worked around in a shader.

title: GradientTexture2D: Support starting and ending radius (Radial gradient focal point)
